comments.body: 2026-11-11: fixed on main (fbb29ff9): resize and even-out pick dividers in the tree the window draws, placeholders included, mapped to the whole tree as a divider drag already was. A resize or even naming a pane the window does not draw is refused.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description: From the 2026-10-24 round review, read from code. In muster_core::spanning, Change::Resize (turns_to, resize::divider) and Change::Even (equalize::dividers) work on the merged tree; only Change::Ratio maps through drawn/whole_path. A window that reaches only some of a tab's machines can pick a divider whose other side it does not draw, report success, and move nothing visible.
title: Resize and equalize in a spanning tab pick dividers in the whole tree, not the tree the window draws
